name: Carolina Yarn & Fabrics Inc
old_description: Carolina Yarn and Fabrics, LLC, based in Laurens, SC, is a leading manufacturer and principal supplier of highly engineered fabric-formed concrete erosion control and scour protection systems. These systems have been utilized for more than 40 years around the world.
about:
Carolina Yarn & Fabrics Inc operates from Laurens, South Carolina. The company traces its origins to 1984 when the ARMORFORM trade name was established for fabric-formed concrete revetments.

The company manufactures ARMORFORM fabric-formed concrete systems for erosion control, scour protection, and lining applications. Its process involves weaving double-layer geotextiles from polyester or nylon yarns, which serve as forms for casting high-strength, fine-aggregate concrete. The forms can be placed underwater or on dry land. The company also provides engineering support, project management, and field services.

Carolina Yarn & Fabrics serves engineering firms, government agencies, and commercial contractors across infrastructure, water management, environmental protection, industrial, and energy sectors. Notable projects include the Endicott Island installation inside the Arctic Circle, MSHA-approved mining applications, U.S. Navy underwater pipeline and cable protection, and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers' Olmsted Locks and Dam scour protection.

The company emphasizes engineered products backed by comprehensive technical support and responsive delivery, which it says drives repeat business from long-standing clients. It positions itself as a trusted partner that assembles multidisciplinary teams to deliver sustainable solutions, focusing on meeting client expectations for delivery, innovation, quality, and service.
